raw_segments.text: I know her women are about her.
What if I do line one of their hands?
Tease gold which buys admittance oft it doth, yay, and makes Diana's rangers false themselves,
yield up their deer to T.H., stand O.T.H.
Steeler, and tease gold which makes the true man killed and saves the thief, nay, sometime
hangs both thief and true man.
What can it not do and undo?
I will make one of her women lawyer to me, for I yet not understand the case myself.
